as_told.title: Silent craft hovers 40 ft above car at Brook Park strip mall
as_told.place_text: Brook Park, Ohio, near NASA John Glenn Research Center

plain: The filmmaker Tim Alberino says a UFO once came down and hovered silently about 40 feet above his car, "like I was supposed to see it." He tells it as his own sighting, and in a second retelling adds that it happened about 14 years ago in February, at a strip mall in Brook Park, Ohio, near a NASA research center called NASA Glenn, with a friend named Tony beside him.
